items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: Well you remember the old Sid Caesar bit when he was Progress Hornsby and he had the radar antenna on the bell of his tenor

ctx.x: And everybody was into atonality at the time.
Oh yeah, and still are. Well you remember the old Sid Caesar bit when he was Progress Hornsby and he had the radar antenna on the bell of his tenor, and that’s in case he got too close to the melody.
Oh that’s good. I wasn’t aware of that.
